liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer says the Deal is hot [15]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Bertha into Sugar Magnolia segment the show stopper [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Times They Are A Changin'**: rare: 5 archived performances [20]
- **Man Of Peace**: rare: 5 archived performances [20]
- **I'll Be Your Baby Tonight**: rare: 5 archived performances [20]
- **I Want You**: rare: 4 archived performances [20]
- **Highway 61 Revisited**: rare: 3 archived performances [20]
- **Ballad Of A Thin Man**: rare: 10 archived performances [20]
- **Shelter From The Storm**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Slow Train Coming**: rare: 3 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-24.138228.AKG460omni.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 230 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1987-07-24.pzm.russjcan.92568.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 35 songs; 222 min; rated 4.33/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording clear, with the P.A. system very distinct, and captures interesting crowd chatter [8]
- **gd1987-07-24.sbdAud.dad.97493.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 14 songs; 84 min; rated 3.92/5 by 13 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the Dead sound great in this soundboard-audience matrix, but Dylan is badly out of tune throughout; Reviewer hears Dylan's voice as raw and gritty, with the Dead sounding great [18][19]
- **gd1987-07-24.schoeps.painoman.17353.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 36 songs; 226 min; rated 1/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- The show includes a set with Dylan, which the reviewer values [9]
- Third set features Dylan's singing, which this reviewer found hard to listen to [10]
- Garcia plays pedal steel during the show; reviewer wishes he had used it more often [16]
- Jerry Garcia plays pedal steel during the show [19]
- Reviewer found no standout song renditions and few jams: only one song runs over ten minutes despite thirty-some songs [10]
- Reviewer considers this the highest-quality of the Dylan/Dead uploads in circulation [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-24.138228.AKG460omni.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rick Gastwirk; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: AKG 460 omni > Sony PCM-F1 > Dat; Recorded Fob; From the collection of Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/44.1;… [1]
- **gd1987-07-24.pzm.russjcan.92568.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat-Mounted Realistic PZM's > Sony WMD6-C > MAC (Maxell MX 90, no nr) [2]. Also: Taper recorded with microphones mounted on his head; reviewer notes an official vault release exists on DVD or CD; Reviewer had previously needed the DVD to hear this show; this upload makes it available as audio files; The recording was made using hat-mounted microphones [9][13][14][15]
- **gd1987-07-24.sbdAud.dad.97493.flac16**: source: Primary source: Soundboard Sony multi-track PCM master > mixdown cassette [recorded on Sony TCD5M] > Sony F1 PCM Beta tape > Beta PCM clone > CD [digital… [4]
- **gd1987-07-24.schoeps.painoman.17353.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Sir Paino; source: (schoeps CMC 32s)>DAT>CDM [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Stadium - July 24, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-24-1987) [21]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-07-24 Fri Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Stadium, Oakland, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1396549743943/grateful-dead-1987-07-24-fri-oakland) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Stadium - July 24, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-24-1987) [23]
